assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single traditional antique English fairy tale BOOK FRONT COVER for Tin Heart. NO soldier, NO people, NO puppet, NO character illustration, NO Chinese characters anywhere. The ONLY text is exact English title "TIN HEART" in LARGE exquisite decorative antique serif hand-lettering, two centered lines, and small exact English subtitle "A FAIRY TALE" near bottom. Dusty deep blue cover, warm antique cream/gold lettering, elaborate but childlike gold ornamental border of leaves and tiny stars. Beneath title at center a small beautiful tin heart emblem with simple crayon silver texture, surrounded by delicate floral ornament. Balanced traditional old English storybook composition, readable title dominates. Front cover flat straight-on, spine on left, cream page block visible along bottom/right. Rough wax crayon and colored pencil drawn on grainy warm paper, uneven pigment, irregular handdrawn lines, naive yet beautiful handmade children's fairy tale aesthetic, NOT smooth digital illustration, NOT 3D, NOT glossy. White scissor-cut border, entire single complete rectangular book visible and isolated TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no outer haze. Again: absolutely no soldier or human figure and absolutely no Chinese, only TIN HEART and A FAIRY TALE.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE anatomically correct human child's hand cutout for a 2D paper puppet animation. New design, do NOT copy any previous malformed hand. Forearm descends vertically from top edge. Seen from back of right hand at a gentle three-quarter side angle. Index finger extends DOWN from its knuckle at the upper-left side of palm and curves inward just at its tip. Thumb emerges from its anatomically correct base on RIGHT side of palm, angled down-left to gently oppose the index finger, with a natural SMALL pinch gap between their fingertips near bottom center. Middle, ring and little fingers curl naturally into palm behind index, do not sprout from wrist or outer thumb. Exactly FIVE fingers, one thumb only, distinct correct knuckles, fingers do NOT form a ring or OK gesture. Relaxed pinch holding an invisible tiny toy at torso. Normal short child's forearm and soft hand proportions. Crayon and colored pencil on warm cream paper, peach skin, irregular brown hand-drawn contours, white uneven scissor-cut border. Entire single hand fully visible except upper forearm cut at top. Portrait. Transparent background with absolutely no outer glow, no gradient, no shadow haze. No text, no soldier or other objects. Natural anatomy takes priority over stylization.
